headline: Moneyview issues notice for postal ballot meeting
hook: Postal ballot notice sent to shareholders
summary: Moneyview Limited has notified the stock exchange regarding a notice of postal ballot for its shareholders. Indian retail investors holding unlisted or specific securities tied to the company should review the ballot details. headline: Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas advises Moneyview on its ₹1,091.68 crore IPO
hook: Law firm advises on a fintech debut
summary: Law firm Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas & Co. acted as legal counsel for Moneyview Limited on its upcoming initial public offering worth ₹1,091.68 crore. Legal advisories for major IPOs highlight active corporate pipelines in the Indian financial sector.
